population.kidComparison: About 85.9 million people live in Türkiye—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Temperate four-season climate with warm summers and cool to cold winters.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Türkiye
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Türkiye.

exploration.didYouKnow: Türkiye is located in Western Asia and its capital city is Ankara.
